mapper.select: SELECT * FROM fin_expense_verify_batch WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND dept_id = #{deptId} AND request_id = #{requestId}

SELECT b.* FROM fin_expense_verify_batch b JOIN fin_expense_verify_detail d ON d.batch_id=b.batch_id AND d.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND d.dept_id=b.dept_id WHERE d.expense_id=#{expenseId} AND b.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND b.dept_id=#{deptId} ORDER BY b.batch_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM fin_expense_verify_batch WHERE batch_id = #{batchId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND dept_id = #{deptId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT e.* FROM fin_expense e JOIN fin_expense_verify_detail d ON d.expense_id=e.expense_id WHERE d.batch_id=#{batchId} AND d.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND d.dept_id=#{deptId} AND e.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND e.dept_id=#{deptId} AND e.del_flag='0' ORDER BY e.expense_id FOR UPDATE

SELECT a.* FROM fin_advance a JOIN fin_advance_verify_detail d ON d.advance_id=a.advance_id WHERE d.batch_id=#{batchId} AND d.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND d.dept_id=#{deptId} AND a.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND a.dept_id=#{deptId} AND a.del_flag='0' ORDER BY a.advance_id FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fin_expense_verify_batch (batch_no, request_id, tenant_id, dept_id, total_expense_amount, total_advance_amount, difference_amount, status, source_type, verify_by, verify_time, reverse_by, reverse_time, reverse_reason, reverse_request_id, version, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{batchNo}, #{requestId}, #{tenantId}, #{deptId}, #{totalExpenseAmount}, #{totalAdvanceAmount}, #{differenceAmount}, #{status}, #{sourceType}, #{verifyBy}, #{verifyTime}, #{reverseBy}, #{reverseTime}, #{reverseReason}, #{reverseRequestId}, #{version}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})

INSERT INTO fin_expense_verify_detail (batch_id, expense_id, tenant_id, dept_id, expense_amount, original_status, original_advance_id, period_id, create_time) VALUES
(#{item.batchId}, #{item.expenseId}, #{item.tenantId}, #{item.deptId}, #{item.expenseAmount}, #{item.originalStatus}, #{item.originalAdvanceId}, #{item.periodId}, #{item.createTime})

INSERT INTO fin_advance_verify_detail (batch_id, advance_id, tenant_id, dept_id, advance_amount, original_status, period_id, relation_type, generated_flag, create_time) VALUES
(#{item.batchId}, #{item.advanceId}, #{item.tenantId}, #{item.deptId}, #{item.advanceAmount}, #{item.originalStatus}, #{item.periodId}, #{item.relationType}, #{item.generatedFlag}, #{item.createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT detail_id, batch_id, expense_id, tenant_id, dept_id, expense_amount, original_status, original_advance_id, period_id, create_time FROM fin_expense_verify_detail WHERE batch_id = #{batchId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND dept_id = #{deptId} ORDER BY detail_id

SELECT detail_id, batch_id, advance_id, tenant_id, dept_id, advance_amount, original_status, period_id, relation_type, generated_flag, create_time FROM fin_advance_verify_detail WHERE batch_id = #{batchId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND dept_id = #{deptId} ORDER BY detail_id
mapper.update: UPDATE fin_expense SET status=#{originalStatus}, advance_id=#{originalAdvanceId}, verify_by=NULL, verify_time=NULL, update_time=SYSDATE() WHERE expense_id=#{expenseId} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND dept_id=#{deptId} AND status='1' AND del_flag='0' AND advance_id <=> #{expectedAdvanceId} AND verify_by <=> #{verifyBy} AND verify_time <=> #{verifyTime}
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fin_advance_verify_detail d JOIN fin_expense_verify_batch b ON b.batch_id=d.batch_id AND b.tenant_id=d.tenant_id WHERE d.advance_id=#{advanceId} AND d.batch_id<>#{batchId} AND d.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND d.dept_id=#{deptId} AND b.dept_id=#{deptId} AND b.status='VERIFIED') + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fin_expense e WHERE e.advance_id=#{advanceId} AND e.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND e.dept_id=#{deptId} AND e.del_flag='0' AND e.status='1')

SELECT batch_id, batch_no, request_id, tenant_id, dept_id, total_expense_amount, total_advance_amount, difference_amount, status, source_type, verify_by, verify_time, reverse_by, reverse_time, reverse_reason, reverse_request_id, version, create_time, update_time FROM fin_expense_verify_batch WHERE batch_id = #{batchId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND dept_id = #{deptId}

SELECT d.detail_id, d.batch_id, d.expense_id, d.tenant_id, d.dept_id, d.expense_amount, d.original_status, d.original_advance_id, d.period_id, d.create_time, e.expense_no, e.expense_content, e.expense_date, e.expense_type FROM fin_expense_verify_detail d LEFT JOIN fin_expense e ON e.expense_id = d.expense_id AND e.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND e.dept_id = d.dept_id WHERE d.batch_id = #{batchId} AND d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND d.dept_id = #{deptId} ORDER BY d.detail_id

SELECT d.detail_id, d.batch_id, d.advance_id, d.tenant_id, d.dept_id, d.advance_amount, d.original_status, d.period_id, d.relation_type, d.generated_flag, d.create_time, a.advance_no, a.purpose, a.advance_date FROM fin_advance_verify_detail d LEFT JOIN fin_advance a ON a.advance_id = d.advance_id AND a.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND a.dept_id = d.dept_id WHERE d.batch_id = #{batchId} AND d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND d.dept_id = #{deptId} ORDER BY d.detail_id
